title: Remi Wolf Announces New Single ‘Bottle’ and Upcoming Album ‘Mud’: ‘It Has Been a Very Cleansing Record to Make For Me’
summary: The 11-track project, due Oct. 9, marks a new era for the alternative pop artist.
contentText:
Remi Wolf is officially ready to welcome her new sonic era.

On Tuesday (Aug. 18), the singer-songwriter announced her third studio album, Mud , due Oct. 9.

Remi Wolf Talks ‘Getting Used To The Chaos’ Following Release Of Debut Album ‘Juno’

“My third album, Mud , is out October 9th. My favorite, my healer, my family, my precious, my blood, sweat and tears. No more secrets!! I love this music more than anything. I wanna scream and cry!!! Okay, let’s breathe …” Wolf wrote in the caption of an Instagram post announcing the album. She also revealed that her next single, “Bottle,” will arrive Thursday (Aug. 20).

The 11-track project reflects Wolf’s evolution as a singer-songwriter, sounding more grounded and introspective than her previous albums, Juno and Big Ideas . Building on the world introduced by lead single “Twiggy,” Mud showcases a warmer, more spacious sound rooted in live instrumentation and organic storytelling.

According to a press release, Mud was born out of a period of reflection following years of nonstop touring alongside global artists such as Olivia Rodrigo and Lorde. To recharge her creative process, Wolf traveled to Nashville and later attended a retreat in Big Bear, California, with a close circle of friends and musicians, where they spent time creating music and enjoying each other’s company.

“I feel like I’ve crossed into a new phase of life because of this album,” Wolf said in a press release. “I literally felt like I was covered in sh-t. And now, at the end of the album process, I feel so clean and clear. It has been a very cleansing record to make for me.”
